text: dsh-vietnamese-lang 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的越南语界面语言包。它作为客户端插件注入 locale 服务，将 Tiếng Việt 添加为可选语言，并向多个界面命名空间注册越南语词条，覆盖会话、设置、工作区、模型选择和文档预览等界面内容。选择越南语后，插件会保存语言偏好，并在 locale 服务重新接入时尝试恢复。适合希望用越南语操作 DSH Web 界面的用户。安装通过 DSH CLI 的 web profile 完成；代码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-vietnamese-lang adds Vietnamese translations to the DSH web interface by registering language strings with its locale service. Choose Tiếng Việt in language settings; the choice is saved in browser storage and restored later. It requires no API key or external service.
我想把 DSH 网页界面切换成越南语。
让 DSH 的设置、会话和工作区界面显示越南语。
Can I use the DSH web interface in Vietnamese?
dsh-vietnamese-lang 的功能「越南语词条」：客户端向 locale 服务注册内置越南语词典，供 DSH Web 界面切换显示。
dsh-vietnamese-lang 的功能「记住语言选择」：选择越南语后将偏好存入浏览器 localStorage，并在服务重新接入时尝试恢复。

Vietnamese language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) Web UI.

English | [Tiếng Việt](README.vi.md)

dsh-vietnamese-lang README · Features：- **Full Core UI Coverage**: Comprehensive Vietnamese localization across 50 namespaces (Chat, Conversation, Trajectory, Workspace, Settings, Model Selection, Approvals, File Explorer, Terminal, Deliverables, Diff Viewer, Document Previews, and more).
- **Native Integration**: Registered via the official `LocaleRuntime` API and available in `Settings > General > Language`.
- **Automatic Fallback**: Any missing third-party keys gracefully fall back to English.
- **Zero Core Patching**: Runs entirely as a Cordis client plugin via standard ModuleLoader.

dsh-vietnamese-lang README · Installation：Install via the `dsh` CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-vietnamese-lang
```

Or from source / GitHub repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lphuxhuq/dsh-vietnamese-lang
```

After installation, refresh the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, go to **Settings (Cài đặt) > General (Cài đặt chung) > Language (Ngôn ngữ)** and choose **Tiếng Việt**.
